notes.title: Update 2.0!
notes.notes:
[h1]2x more missions:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/1da0a39ea2c80669a4b7ab5c04cff0b9d20cc87a.png[/img]
The amount of content in the game has doubled! New goals, unexpected situations and unique problems await you, which you will have to solve in your own way.

[h1]Special abilities:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/e72b3b0c106a67db18765873e45354650e61d80e.png[/img]
Each agent now has several ultimate abilities to choose from, which can be activated at a critical moment.
Even if everything didn't go according to plan, you have a chance to fix it. Almost always.

[h1]Operations:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/b96deeaeac3669d4f53fe4f4feabf42d01e1e8ec.png[/img]
Operations have appeared in the game - sequences of missions that open like a story campaign. For completing them, you get new gadgets.
Operation "Fools Undercover" (random selection of missions) remains in the game, so don't worry.

[h1]New Skill System:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/0e3b9c094c9fcc43e49a0bd8d74bb3ec042ecab4.png[/img]
We have completely reworked the skill system.
Now you can discover and improve abilities that affect all aspects of the game: from new options for using gadgets to upgrading spy (and other) skills.

[h1]New Gadget System:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/ab84b34fbcb8c2aad17152e5d2a65e80dee9940d.png[/img]
Discover new gadgets and improve their characteristics.
Jammers, decoys, hacking devices - now they work exactly the way you want them to.

[h1]Difficulty and scale separation:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/59706017ee844a4729aba984bed1ba683ba76701.png[/img]
Difficulty no longer affects map size. You can now choose them separately. At each difficulty level, the guards will behave differently, which significantly increases replayability.

[h1]Guards have keycards:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/b782c66a0960e337ad137ae84168fa076ec6f172.png[/img]
Some guards now carry keycards. Want to get into a restricted area? You'll have to be careful, stalk, and take risks.

[h1]Updated prison:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/64171fb7f3276db4802c09345f8c30213d63daa5.png[/img]
Now, while sitting in prison, you can not only watch the cameras, but also watch the entire map from above on a large table. This will make helping the team even more useful.

[h1]Introduction scene:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/a0be9f662c731ed2bf1ca54dad108d31d2cb3785.png[/img]
At the beginning of the game and training, you will see an atmospheric cutscene about how you were selected as a spy.

[h1]Tutorial:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/e6a2ead389894592769d4c4ea4bbdaadad257dff.png[/img]
A full tutorial has been added to help new players understand the game without losing their heads in the first few minutes.

[h1]New mini-games in the lobby:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/4d07c54d90ac69342a0305c888d1eec7fa50ae30.png[/img]
New mini-games have appeared in the lobby: mini-golf and slot machines.

[h1]New Costumes:[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/9b1ad025424c387a3a2f42c62d357e37c8e32e94.png[/img]
Added new stylish (and sometimes absurd) looks for your agents.

[h1]Improved Old Missions:[/h1]
Many missions have been reworked: new routes, changed objectives, and a more balanced pacing. Even if you've completed them before, you'll have to adapt!

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
We've fixed a lot of bugs, including critical ones that could break the game.

[h1]Animated Mouths :)[/h1]
Players' mouths now move when they speak.

notes.title: Update 2.0 coming soon! Release date: June 5th
notes.notes:
The update comes out on June 5. And it's the biggest update in the history of Undercover Fools.

We didn't just add content - we rebuilt the game entirely. Below is just a part of what awaits you:

📌 2x more missions:
You'll find new goals, new situations, and new problems that you'll have to deal with in your own way. The amount of content in the game has doubled!

📌 Special abilities:
Each agent now has several ultimate abilities to choose from, which can be activated at a critical moment.
If everything doesn't go according to plan, you can still get out of it. Almost always.

📌 Operations:
The game will feature operations, where you can play specific missions. They will be arranged in order and unlocked like a story campaign. They will also unlock new gadgets. Operation: Undercover Fools (Random selection of missions) will remain in the game, don't worry.

📌 New Skills Tab:
The skill system has been reworked.
You will be able to open and upgrade abilities that affect all aspects of your game: new unique ways to use gadgets, as well as upgrade spy (and other) skills.

📌 New Gadgets Tab:
Open access to gadgets and improve their characteristics.
Jammers, decoys, hacking devices - now they work exactly the way you need them to.

📌 Separation of difficulty and map scale:
Difficulty no longer affects the size of the map. You will be able to choose the size of the map and the difficulty of the game separately. At each difficulty, there will be different guards on the entire map, and so on every time, which will greatly add replayability.

📌 Keycards for guards:
Now guards can carry keycards with them. Want to get into a closed area? You will have to take risks, track and act carefully.

📌 Old missions updated:
Many missions have been reworked: new routes, changed goals, a more logical pace. Even if you've completed them before, you'll have to adapt.

📌 Tutorial:
A full tutorial has been added to help newcomers understand the system without losing their heads in the first five minutes.

📌 New costumes:
There are new looks that you can unlock and put on. Some are absurd. Some are frighteningly stylish.

📌 Many bugs have been fixed:
Many bugs have been fixed, including critical ones that broke the entire game. All of them have been fixed.

Initially, the update was planned to be called 1.1, but it was decided to rename it to 2.0, because the game not only has 2-3 times more content, but also many mechanics have been completely reworked.

June 5. Undercover Fools is changing. And you are changing with it.
Get ready for a new level of espionage.

notes.title: Plans for update 1.1 - Undercover Fools
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/32a5d76ba9e843d16a21d29d045d061192ee8437.png[/img]
1) Separation of building scale and game difficulty:
In the upcoming update, when creating a lobby, you will be able to separately select the scale of the generated map: small, medium, large, very large. For example, if you are playing for the first time, but entered the lobby with a large company - you will be able to play on a large map with easy difficulty. Or if you want to play on high difficulties, but you do not have much time - you will be able to start the game on high difficulty with a small map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/dd6cc75093e4be83b25af668a81c7f734fa518a7.png[/img]
2) Key cards at the guards:
Key cards that spawn in random places will also have a chance to appear on the guard's belt, be careful to pick them up carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/baa35fdd5825a2ce698db98aac8b453ea43f50f9.png[/img]
3) Perk system:
You will be able to choose one passive skill that will give you an advantage in some aspects of the game, diversifying the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45218180/f3fb1215a410f5600cf5f41c2fd560caa2341090.png[/img]
4) Building security:
In each room, the number of guards will change depending on the difficulty, which will greatly affect the gameplay. This will help beginners get used to it easier, and those who already know the game well - to test themselves.

5) New tasks:
Of course - the update will have several new interesting tasks, which will also be randomly selected when generating the map, like the rest.

6) Updating old tasks:
The tasks that are already in the game will be added new variants of rooms and guards in them, which will increase the variety of the passage.

7) Voice visualization:
If the player speaks in the voice chat, then his model's mouth will move.

8) New costumes and emotes:
New costumes and emotes will be added.

This list may be updated until the update is released.
If you have any ideas or you have noticed a bug, you can write to us:
Discord: https://discord.gg/Jkp5KTA44P
Email: xdicesup@gmail.com

notes.title: Hotfix: Bug fixes
notes.notes:
This update fixes several bugs:

1) Fixed translation of employee names in the computer room. After restarting the game, clients now see the correct names, as intended.

3) Fixed a bug with the cutter sound. In some cases, it could remain on indefinitely for clients. Now the sound is correctly disabled.

Thank you for your feedback!
